notes.title: ANONYMOUS;CODE Launch Day
notes.content:
The latest installment in the Science Adventure series, [i]ANONYMOUS;CODE[/i] is almost here!
[i]ANONYMOUS;CODE[/i] will be released today on Steam at [u]10am PDT[/u]!

A full soundtrack, artbook DLC, and the Digital Deluxe Edition bundle will also be made available upon release. There will also be a 10% launch discount applied to purchases made during the first week of the release.

Please stay tuned for more details!
